baselineResult: Main and required authentication commit are ancestors of the starting working commit; no divergence or merge conflict.

sourceFingerprint.method: Sorted tracked/unignored source and configuration paths, excluding docs/artifacts; hash path NUL bytes NUL. Private ignored environments, credentials, traces and generated runtime wrappers are excluded.

authorizedWorkspaceReload.behavior: Actual workspace picker selects an authorized non-first workspace; a hard reload retains it only after real authentication and membership validation.

minuteBookDocumentACL.priorCoverage: The initial 416-case suite did not qualify a private core document inside a fresh bounded binder preview. Follow-up review identified a false completeness/missing-core-document diagnosis when ACLs hide supporting evidence.
minuteBookDocumentACL.behavior: A private core document remains visible to Owner. Viewer receives generic access-limited coverage and an unknown core-completeness check, without private titles or a false missing-core-document diagnosis.
minuteBookDocumentACL.setup: Fresh disposable synthetic workspace; production document creation uses a real Owner session, then temporary memberships and fixture rows are removed.

privatePortal.setup: Actual workspace/director/portal APIs create a separate synthetic workspace; board-only scope, no downloads and no email operations.
privatePortal.credentialHandling: The portal token is retained only in the ignored private fixture and private browser evidence.

exclusions.reason: Static-demo-only developer lab; hosted safely redirects to landing. Local suite qualifies the actual lab.

states: Positive scoped private portal in a separate synthetic workspace
Native storage bytes and persistent bound images

powerSync.scope: Meeting preparation pilot with actual SDK SQLite/outbox, native commands/files and experimental Convex connector.

npm run verify:reconciled.scope: Authentication, Clerk gateway, Microsoft tenant restrictions, identity/workspace/module/role/Owner protection, uploads, public intake, participant authority, protected projections, server typecheck and combined build

focused lint.notes: No errors; existing structural/hook warnings. Repository lint configuration excludes some test/config files; their executed browser checks and applicable typechecks are separate.

limitations: PowerSync is the qualified meeting pilot; production credential delivery and remaining ACL/identity/expiry invalidation hooks are pending. Other modules have not been converted to offline replicas.
Actual full-app login uses isolated Better Auth email sessions/native Convex storage; external Clerk/Microsoft login and external RustFS/R2/provider connections require their own live qualification.
Chromium viewport/touch emulation, not physical devices, Safari or a packaged Electron release.
All planned cases passed through documented full/focused manual reruns; this is not one uninterrupted green run. Initial failures and excluded interrupted/unstarted cases remain recorded.
Large build chunks remain a performance follow-up; no load or Lighthouse benchmark is claimed.
publication: Working-branch commit only; no main push, public deployment or production tenant changes.
